definitions.AB_coverage: Both groups require positive actual compute overlap on each individual NPU
definitions.demand: Decimal GB/s. Sum active request per-disk V/C; extra next-request L0 excluded
definitions.ordering: explicit/cyclic is phase-controlled deterministic ordering, not random
definitions.physical_bandwidth: Nominal demand and pending envelope are not physical SSD throughput
definitions.short_runs: Unavailable named windows are not clipped; final 2s bin may be partial
definitions.utilization: Exact compute overlap / (NPU count * window duration)
